lowerBound.argument: deficiencies 5, 6 and 7 were excluded by the earlier support/equality, full-pencil-pair, and seven-line support theorems. At deficiency 8 the defect is forced to be plus/minus one valued. Each eight-line sign support has minimum intersection degree four. In W(3,5) the only realizable support type is K4 square K2; the K4,4 alternative would require at least four common transversals to a disjoint triple, while the exact symplectic census is only 0 or 2. PSp(4,5) is transitive on ordered noncollinear point pairs, so all support types are covered by the 15 four-of-six matched-pair choices for one representative. Each has a unique cross-disjoint opposite 4-core, and all 15 exact 26-point occupancy targets are infeasible.
